Antigua Guatemala: historic façades and a volcano beyond the street

## Two routes, one after the other

The Guatemalan leg takes in colonial Antigua, Maya villages around Lake Atitlán, the market in Chichicastenango and ancient Tikal. After flying to San José, you continue through Costa Rica, visiting the Arenal area, the Caño Negro reserve, the Tárcoles River, Manuel Antonio and the Tamarindo coast.

Poás, the La Paz waterfalls, Monteverde and Tortuguero are outside the day-by-day programme for this tour. To visit them, arrange a separate extension to the itinerary with us.
